decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - No deliveries shall be taken at or despatched from the site outside the hours of 8.00am and 8.00pm nor at any time on Sundays, Bank or Public Holidays.

Condition : 4 - Before the development hereby permitted is commenced a scheme indicating the provision to be made for disabled people to gain access to the retail units shall have been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority.  The agreed scheme shall be implemented before the development hereby permitted is brought into use.

Condition : 5 - Before first occupation of the buildings the loading, unloading and turning space, and parking spaces (including spaces for people with disabilities) shall be provided within the curtilage of the site in accordance with the scheme shown on drawing No. 2006/0521/15/C and such spaces shall be permanently available and not be used for any other purpose.
Condition : 6 - The retail units shall remain as independent units and shall not be enlarged without the written agreement of the Local Planning Authority

Condition : 7 - The two crossovers on Teesdale Avenue shall be narrowed to ensure pedestrians do not have to negotiate large crossovers and the crossover adjacent to parking bays 20- 21 on London Road shall be closed and the footpath reinstated at the applicant's expense
Condition : 8 - The amended loading, unloading and turning and parking spaces shall be laid out and completed within three calender months of the permission hereby granted.
description: Variation of condition 6 of planning permission 00707/317-331/P2 (Change of use from car dealership to 4 x A1 retail units) to allow fthe loading, unloading and turning spaces and parking spaces in accordance with Boreham's Drawing No 205232/6/A.
